headline: Veteran journalist and former editor of The News Husain Naqi passed away in Lahore on Sunday morning after a cardiac arrest, Dawn reports; President Zardari expressed grief, APP reports.

card.desc: The News ke sabiq editor aur HRCP rukn ka Lahore mein inteqal

caption:
Senior sahafi aur insani huqooq ki mazboot awaz Husain Naqi chal base. 🕊️
Dawn ke mutabiq The News ke sabiq editor Husain Naqi Sunday subah 5 baje Lahore mein inteqal kar gaye. Saturday shaam HRCP ki ek kitab ki taqreeb ke baad unhein dil ka daura para tha. Woh teen dahaiyon tak HRCP se wabasta rahe aur Punjabi zuban ke pehle daily akhbar "Sajjan" ke bani the. APP ke mutabiq Sadr Asif Ali Zardari ne un ki wafat par gehre dukh ka izhar kiya.
Allah marhoom ki maghfirat farmaye. Aap unhein kis tarah yaad karte hain? Comment mein batayein 👇
